name: grok-bot-control
description: Safely coordinate with Grok Bot through a verified UI surface and review experimental CLI options.

interface.shortDescription: Reliable Grok Bot handoffs with readback and duplicate-send protection.
interface.longDescription: Provides a reusable coordination workflow for an already-authorized Grok Bot conversation. It documents verified macOS CUA controls, evidence-based handoffs, waiting rules, and the limits of the experimental grok-bot-cli path.
defaultPrompt: Use $grok-bot-control to coordinate this task with my authorized Grok Bot conversation.
Review the latest Grok Bot reply and verify its artifacts before continuing.
Check whether Grok Bot is stalled and prepare one safe follow-up if due.
